item.title: Police investigating after device thrown at anti-Islam protest in New York City
item.description: NEW YORK — A counterprotester demonstrating against a “Stop the Islamic Takeover of New York City” event Saturday lit and threw a device containing nuts, bolts and screws at the protesting crowd after someone from that group used pepper spray on the counterprotest, police said.

item.title: What Texas tells us about the 2026 midterms
item.description: The early political signals emerging from Texas may offer a revealing preview of the national mood heading into the 2026 midterm elections. While one state rarely defines the entire political landscape, Texas often serves as an important barometer for the broader tensions shaping American politics today: polarization, ideological intensity and growing voter fatigue with both.

item.title: University presidents face a ‘Star Trek’-like Kobayashi Maru moment
item.description: Should university presidents publicly weigh in on the most pressing societal issues of our times? In some academic circles, especially at public universities, it is now common for presidents to adopt a policy of neutrality. For presidents of faith-based universities, taking a position of neutrality can be problematic since the religious order that sponsors your institution believes that attacks on human dignity are not political matters but rather moral ones.

item.title: Tell Giselle: Happiness from a higher source
item.description: “I’m not as happy as I used to be. Nothing seems to get me very excited. Even the job I am good at, that pays the bills and supports my family, doesn’t feel like enough anymore. Why isn’t it longer lasting?”

item.title: The Luzerne Foundation’s scholarship portal closing soon!
item.description: Local students have a valuable opportunity to turn their academic achievements and ambitions into scholarship support for college. The Luzerne Foundation’s scholarship portal will close on March 11, 2026. With nearly 100 scholarship opportunities available, students are encouraged to explore and submit their applications through the portal on our website at www.luzfdn.org before the deadline.
